announcements.title: Welcome to my new Website🙏
announcements.message:
After 18 years, it was time for a refresh

Whether you join me for Yoga, Sound therapy, Reiki or a Yoga retreat - you’re not just joining a class or experience - you’re becoming part of a warm supportive community where we can learn, grow and reconnect with ourselves and one another.

I look forward to welcoming you and sharing the journey together🕉

Love & light

Maureen xx🙏🥰
